mathematical_checks.result: Every odd m≥3, integer d≥2 and legal positive real u_i,v_i, nonnegative degree≤d fees including zero, same fees for action copies: whole min{2,Td} existence plus separate pool Td existence. Costs are true deviating-load delays without multiplying player weight.

Odd m rules out zero conflicts. A unique conflict fixes the action profile modulo global bit flip, and same-fee copies preserve every cost. The only strict candidate deviations are the two adjacent players; each moves the defect one position.

At α≥1, reverse costs exclude two opposite strict arcs on one edge even with zero costs. If every vertex had an outgoing strict arc, all 2m edges would be used and coherently oriented. Failure of both complete strict orientations therefore supplies a weak α-PNE.

For f_d(R)=[R(1+R)^d+1]/[(1+R)^d+R^(d+1)], f_d(1)=1 and f′_d(1)=(2^d−d−1)/(2^d+1)>0 for d≥2. Thus Td>1 and the envelope positive-denominator argument applies at α=Td; strict tests exclude the endpoint.

A_i→B_i: F_i(u_i+v_i)+G_i(v_i)>α[F_i(v_i)+G_i(u_(i+1)+v_i)]. B_i→A_(i+1): F_(i+1)(u_(i+1))+G_i(u_(i+1)+v_i)>α[F_(i+1)(u_(i+1)+v_(i+1))+G_i(u_(i+1))]. These are exactly n_i=1 envelope tests with positive amplitudes one.

F_i=0 makes A_i→B_i impossible by nonnegative monotonicity; G_i=0 makes B_i→A_(i+1) impossible. Hence a hypothetical complete strict orientation has nonzero relevant shapes. Pure constants fail the corresponding strict test; constants in mixtures remain in the convex upper bound. No division by costs or 0/0 is required.

With old i=−j mod m: H′_j=L_i, L′_j=H_i, u′_j=v_i, v′_j=u_i; preserve action bits, A′_j^b=A_i^b, B′_j^b=B_(i−1)^(1−b), F′_j=F_i, G′_j=G_(i−1). The new hub incoming and light outgoing resource are exactly the old resources, preserving loads and every true deviation cost. New forward A′_j→B′_j→A′_(j+1) is old reverse A_i→B_(i−1)→A_(i−1).

A_i^b has potential users H_i,L_i and B_i^b has L_i,H_(i+1). At a global minimum of Ψ=ΣC_i on all pure states, ΔΨ≤2C_i(new)−C_i(old)−C_common; a strict factor-two improvement is impossible. This proof allows zero and arbitrary nonnegative nondecreasing fees; the whole edge only claims the stated polynomial target.
If Td≤2, choose the pool Td-PNE for the whole min conclusion. If 2<Td choose the global 2-PNE; retain the independent pool Td-PNE. The two witnesses may differ, and equality Td=2 is harmless.
